name: NetLogo
description: Open-source, Logo-based programmable modeling environment designed for simulating natural and social phenomena through agent-based modeling with an accessible yet powerful IDE.
reputation: One of the most widely used and respected open-source ABM platforms in education, social science, and interdisciplinary research worldwide.
notes: Low threshold for beginners but high ceiling for complex models; strong focus on visualization and BehaviorSpace experimentation.

institutions: Northwestern University Center for Connected Learning and Computer-Based Modeling
